relevance.rationale: IDENTIFICATION MISMATCH — the file is a mis-assembled upload. I read pages 1-3, 15, 17, 30, 32, 41 and 44: the PDF contains two Arcus papers on generalized Lie algebroids (exterior differential calculus, Maurer-Cartan and Cartan-type theorems, (rho,h)-curvature) concatenated, plus orphaned tail pages of a third document. This confirms independently what docs/audits/2026-08-01-em-linking-reads-round1.md line 52 already recorded: expected 'DGKMSV, generalized Gauss maps', actually contains 'Arcus (Lie algebroids, unrelated) x2 + orphaned tail pages (§48-56) of DeTurck-Gluck'. Judged on its actual contents, the document is not relevant: generalized Lie algebroids in the sense of Arcus are a solo-author generalization with no contact with the corpus's Reeb-bundle, state-bundle or gauge-groupoid constructions, and nothing in it bears on Hecke algebras, knot invariants, hyperbolic volume or q-deformation. The INTENDED paper (generalized Gauss maps / Milnor triple linking integrals) is a different matter and is genuinely on-topic for the Borromean triple-linking thread — but it is not in this file, so it cannot be triaged from it.

proposedActions.rationale: The document as uploaded supplies nothing usable. Its ledger row should record the mismatch so a later pass does not re-read it expecting DGKMSV; no ref() entry should be created for Arcus.

Re-upload request, not a computation: the corpus wants arXiv:0901.1612 (announcement) and arXiv:1207.1793 (Part 2, Euclidean case) for the generalized-Gauss-maps / triple-linking material, per the re-upload list already recorded in the round-1 audit. Flagging it here so the ledger row and the audit's re-upload list stay joined.
